files_digest_method: sha256 of the lines '<path> <sha256>\n' for every file, sorted by path
format: one JSON file per entity, files[<entity>].path: {"cube", "entity", "columns", "rows": [[values in column order]], "periods": {"grain:period": {months, file_version}} (only the windows that entity uses)}
manifest_hash_method: sha256 of data/opm_manifest.json canonical content: records sorted by (dataset, filename), json.dumps(sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"))
spec: D-099, D-100 (Who is joining: hires by group, rates per 100 of the group's mean headcount as doj_leaving; prior federal service and early-career programs as shares); D-023, D-024, D-027, D-089; docs/metric-spec.md

grains.fy: fiscal year; rate = method B form (D-019); a partial fiscal year is year to date over its published months, not annualized (D-023)
grains.t12: the 12 months ending at period_last_month; rate = method A form (D-019); from Sep 2012
grains.admin: an administration's whole window (D-065, D-066), period = its id; rate = hires over the window x 12 / months / mean month-end headcount (annualized, D-066); partial while in office (Trump II)
grains.admin_n: months 1..N in office for every administration, N = admin_n_months (the open administration's months so far, D-072), period = the administration id; rate annualized as admin (D-066); months_in_period and rate_months record N (fewer where D-024 cuts the window)

dimension_kinds_note: rate: every value but Unknown has rate_num / rate_den per 100 of the value's mean headcount; share: hires / share_den (hires with a known value), no rate and no headcount (is_share); Unknown values: counts only

columns.name: entity
columns.description: 'DOJ' or a component's agency_subelement_code

columns.name: grain
columns.description: 'fy' (fiscal year), 't12' (12 months ending at period_last_month), 'admin' (an administration's whole window, D-066) or 'admin_n' (its months 1..N in office, N = admin_n_months, D-072); never month or quarter (D-031)

columns.name: period
columns.description: 'FYyyyy' at fy grain; 'YYYY-MM' (the window's last month) at t12 grain; the administration id (obama2, trump1, biden, trump2) at admin and admin_n grain

columns.name: fiscal_year
columns.description: fiscal year of the period (of its last month at t12 grain)

columns.name: period_first_month
columns.description: first month of the window (YYYY-MM)

columns.name: period_last_month
columns.description: last published month of the window, where headcount is taken (YYYY-MM)

columns.name: months_in_period
columns.description: months in a full window: 12

columns.name: months_published
columns.description: months of the window with a published employment file, up to the entity's last month (D-024; a component continued at 0 runs to the latest month, D-089)

columns.name: dimension
columns.description: a dimension of pipeline/crosswalks/leaving_dimensions.csv tagged joining in its cubes column (meta dimensions_file.values): 'age', 'occupation', 'education', 'veteran', 'grade' (rated), 'prior_service' (length of service at hire), 'pathways' (early-career programs) (shares; D-100)

columns.name: value
columns.description: value id within the dimension, as in pipeline/crosswalks/leaving_dimensions.csv

columns.name: value_order
columns.description: display order of the value within its dimension

columns.name: time_basis
columns.description: 'effective': hires by personnel_action_effective_date_month (invariant 6)

columns.name: provisional
columns.description: the window contains any of the newest 3 effective months (invariant 8)

columns.name: partial
columns.description: a fiscal year with months not yet published or after the entity's last employment month (D-023, D-024)

columns.name: reissued
columns.description: a month of the window changed file version since the previous manifest (revision_baseline.json)

columns.name: opm_incomplete
columns.description: a month of the window OPM marks incomplete for DOJ; currently none

columns.name: is_unknown
columns.description: the Unknown value of the dimension: counts only, no rate and no share (D-031, D-100)

columns.name: is_share
columns.description: a share dimension (prior_service, pathways; D-100): hires and share_den, every rate column null and headcount null (there is no on-board count for these groups)

columns.name: hires
columns.description: accession rows effective in the window with this value

columns.name: acc_transfer_in
columns.description: hires with accession code AA (D-015)

columns.name: acc_new_hire
columns.description: hires with accession code AC + AD + AE (D-015)

columns.name: headcount
columns.description: rows with this value in the employment file of period_last_month; null in a share dimension

columns.name: rate_num
columns.description: hires in the window with this value (at admin grain x 12 / months, D-066); rate = rate_num / rate_den (hires per 100 = x 100); null for an Unknown value, a structural zero or a share dimension

columns.name: rate_den
columns.description: mean month-end headcount with this value over the window months (the same denominator as doj_leaving); null for an Unknown value or a share dimension, and null (never 0) when that mean is 0 (D-027)

columns.name: rate_months
columns.description: number of month-end headcounts averaged into rate_den

columns.name: rate_small_base
columns.description: rate_den < 30 (invariant 9); null when there is no rate

columns.name: rate_not_applicable
columns.description: structural zero: nobody with this value on board in any month of the window, so no rate (D-027, D-031); null for an Unknown value or a share dimension

columns.name: share_den
columns.description: share dimensions only: hires in the window whose value for this dimension is known (not Unknown); share = hires / share_den; null on Unknown rows, rated dimensions, and when no hire has a known value (never 0)

columns.name: coverage
columns.description: share of the period's hires whose value for this dimension is known (not the Unknown value); null when there are no hires
